verdict: Service in the focus hours is significantly worse than the baseline on lateness_sec, late_share, problem_share.

evidence: [R] 100% of late trains were already late at Union St (inherited delay). Origins: at or before Whitehall St-South Ferry: 15. Largest time loss on segment Whitehall St-South Ferry -> Court St (median +57s vs schedule).

[N] 100% of late trains were already late at Union St (inherited delay). Origins: at or before Whitehall St-South Ferry: 22, at or before DeKalb Av: 3. Largest time loss on segment Union St -> target (median +45s vs schedule).
[D] 100% of late trains were already late at Union St (inherited delay). Origins: at or before W 4 St-Wash Sq: 27. Largest time loss on segment Grand St -> DeKalb Av (median +60s vs schedule).
[N] 96% of late trains were already late leaving Astoria-Ditmars Blvd: crew/rolling-stock availability or terminal dispatch.
[D] 85% of late trains were already late leaving Norwood-205 St: crew/rolling-stock availability or terminal dispatch.

[R] Time is lost a little at every stop (Whitehall St-South Ferry -> Court St +57s, Jay St-MetroTech -> DeKalb Av +50s, Union St -> target +20s): a dwell-time / crowding pattern rather than one bad segment.

[N] Time is lost a little at every stop (Whitehall St-South Ferry -> Court St +35s, Jay St-MetroTech -> DeKalb Av +25s, Union St -> target +45s): a dwell-time / crowding pattern rather than one bad segment.
[D] 100% of the run-time loss sits on one segment (Grand St -> DeKalb Av, median +60s): a signal timer, speed restriction, or failure on that segment.
58% of problem arrivals occurred during planned service changes (lift 0.7x).

recommendations.action: Audit terminal operations at Norwood-205 St during 02:00-03:00: crew reporting, car availability, turnaround time
recommendations.rationale: Trains leave the terminal already late.
recommendations.expected_effect: On-time departures remove the delay at the source.

recommendations.action: Dwell-time programme at 4 Av-9 St and the stops before it during 02:00-03:00: platform controllers, door-closing announcements, step-back crews
recommendations.rationale: Run-time loss is spread across every stop on the approach, the signature of long dwells.
recommendations.expected_effect: Each stop recovers its excess dwell; the effect compounds along the line.

recommendations.action: Inspect Grand St -> DeKalb Av for a speed restriction, grade-time signal or signal fault; check recent work orders
recommendations.rationale: Most of the run-time loss sits on one segment.
recommendations.expected_effect: Removing the restriction recovers the segment's excess on every trip.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for R, N, D, W; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Check whether scheduled dwell and run times on the approach still match observed loads; re-time the schedule if not
recommendations.rationale: A schedule with unrealistic dwells makes every train late by design.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for R, N, D, W; add supplement trains or move work windows off 02:00-03:00
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.
